claims.text: The local release and selected source snapshot frame the 7th Next Generation World Hobby Fair window as December 7, 1997 through February 1, 1998.
The local child slice models three source-pinned promo cards for the WHF Special Limited Expansion Sheet: Pikachu row 025, Mew row 026, and Mewtwo row 027.
The selected Pokumon timeline lines say the 7th Next Generation World Hobby Fair had a special limited Expansion Sheet on sale with three promo cards.

The selected Bulbapedia lines describe a special preview expansion sheet available at the fair, classify the cards as Unnumbered Promotional cards, and note they are often regarded as additions to the Vending Machine collection and dubbed Series 00.
The local source-provider rows credit Pikachu, Mew, and Mewtwo in this slice to Ken Sugimori, scoped as catalog texture rather than direct physical-card proof.

This slice matters because it is a liminal object: a World Hobby Fair special sheet with unnumbered promotional identity, Vending-adjacent Series 00 memory, and three of the franchise's strongest early faces sharing one small event apparatus.

Agents should preserve WHF Special Limited Expansion Sheet route, December 1997-February 1998 event window, rows 025-027, Series 00 / Vending-adjacent classification caveat, Mew/Mewtwo Song Best overlap, and non-equivalence with ordinary Vending, Song Best, JR, CoroCoro, or later Pikachu/Mew/Mewtwo promos before accepting a match.

narrative.human_title: WHF Special Limited Expansion Sheet — the little Series 00 hinge
narrative.why_it_matters: This is exactly the sort of object the catalog should protect from flattening. It is not just Pikachu, Mew, and Mewtwo, and it is not simply ordinary Vending. It is a special limited sheet sold through the 7th Next Generation World Hobby Fair, remembered beside the Vending Machine collection as Series 00, and later tangled with Song Best memory for Mew and Mewtwo. It feels like Pokemon culture learning how many doors a card can enter through: fair, sheet, promo, vending-adjacent archive, CD overlap, collector shorthand.
